_meta.purpose: Maps Laya's tier / pii_gate output (integrations/laya/laya_route.py) to a concrete route.
_meta.mirrors: CLAUDE.md's model-tiering table and integrations/omniroute/README.md's routing map, 2026-09-28; research tier moved to the subscription route 2026-10-05 (Perplexity removed).
_meta.rule: Change CLAUDE.md's tiering table first, then integrations/omniroute/README.md, then this file to match. Never the other way.
_meta.invariant: pii_gate=true always overrides tier, with no exception. A client-shaped request never reaches the subscription route (research included), whatever tier Laya also guessed.
_meta.note: Route/tier NAMES only, never model names, per CLAUDE.md's naming rule — this file and laya_route.py's output are things Steven (or a log) can grep.

true.note: Overrides tier unconditionally, whatever brain_route/tier said. No cloud fallback, ever: if the local combo can't be reached, the request DEFERS (claude-auto.sh exit 75) — it never reroutes to subscription (research included) or free-fallback. See integrations/omniroute/README.md #hard-rules.

orchestrator.note: Vanessa only — orchestration/council chair/final synthesis. Plain `claude`, OAuth, no proxy env. Never through OmniRoute (see integrations/omniroute/README.md #hard-rules).

executive.note: A C-suite lane owns this outright. Plain `claude`, OAuth, no proxy env. Never through OmniRoute.

worker.note: Report/bench/execution-only seat. Plain `claude`, OAuth, no proxy env. Never through OmniRoute.

research.seat_tier: research tier — the worker tier's model with WebSearch/WebFetch
research.note: Research heavy lifting — Claude web research on Steven's Claude subscription (Perplexity removed 2026-10-05). Plain `claude`, OAuth, no proxy env. Never through OmniRoute. ≤4 web-research sub-agents per wave (CLAUDE.md sub-agent dispatch cap), enforced by the agent that dispatches them, not by this file.

local.fallback: none by construction — a single-target combo; proven only against a stand-in gateway, so the local route stays OFF (OMNIROUTE_LOCAL_MODEL unset) until README §Prove it on the Mac passes
local.provider_id_placeholder: set by setup-local-llm.sh / configure-omniroute.sh at install time — not a fixed value in this file

research.note: Perplexity removed (Steven). Research is subscription traffic now, and the subscription never goes through OmniRoute (README #hard-rules), so there is no research combo and no research provider. configure-omniroute.sh no longer creates either.
